description: Regression benchmark over the synthetic corpus in examples/chats. 'expected' is a message id (file:line) that must appear in the top 10, directly or as context; 'concept' queries must return mentions of the concept; a case with neither must return nothing. This is a small regression set, not a measure of quality on a real corpus.
